title: 第二十一章 的强大与传承第二十二章 寻仙一脉与疑团初解
content_zh:
五仙门却依旧神龙见首，不见尾，始终少现于世。
“强大的仙法，必有其强大的根本原因，上面也和你说了灵根的几个种类。杂灵根、玄灵根、地灵根、天灵根、圣灵根和异灵根。
我们名为五仙门，又分癸水仙门、乙木仙门、丁火仙门、己土仙门、辛金仙门，分别对应的就是五行中感应最灵敏的属性。
像乙木仙门，其修炼的仙法是针对木属性而创造的，所以感应木灵气灵敏的人修炼最好；丁火仙门对应是就是火属性仙法为主。
但五仙门要求不是圣灵根，而是需要一人同时身具五行所有属性才能修炼。”
说到这，灰衫老者话锋顿了一顿。
“杂灵根？”
李言虽然许多事情还处在云里雾里之中，但也是听明白了一些，不由心中奇怪。
“这人说话也当真是奇怪，之前还说修仙之人圣灵根最强，现在好似又在说杂灵根修炼最好了。”
“是杂灵根，这才是古老五仙门派最大的秘密了，只是我们虽然需要的是杂灵根体质之人，但这却不是普通的杂灵根。
说道此处，灰衫老者声音有些低沉，一脸落寞，似有一丝追忆之情。
所以，他必须采用其他低级手段来探测他人是否具有灵根。”
普通的修仙者单就在这凡人界来说，十万人里可能寻得一人，这就是考虑进去了任何一种灵根的存在。
李言听的心中骇然，传说中的仙人竟然离他如此之近，心中所想已表现在了脸上。
每一次传承都要费尽心力方能找到下一代传承之人，每一代基本都是单传或了了几人。
灰衫老者神情一黯，此时他的身影比之刚才又模糊了些许，而李言心中骇浪就没停过，一时倒是未发觉了。
说到这里，灰衫老者脸上露高傲之色，那萎靡的脸上竟有霸气隐现，足见他对自己所修仙法傲视之情。
杂灵根当然就是对金、木、水、火、土五行都有感应，我们不光需要此人身具这五行属性，而且这五行属性必须是按相生之法强弱依次排列。
我们用神识扫视低阶修仙者更加隐蔽可靠，神识是修仙者的一种神通，不用眼睛，便能穿墙穿屋看清一切。
感应天地灵气最强的应该是‘金’，其次才是水、木、火、土’，如果后一项感应强于前一项，则不能修炼‘辛金仙门’的仙法。

那么修炼之人体内五行属性也必须按有五行相生强弱排列。
同样我们‘癸水仙门’感应天地灵气的顺序则是‘水、木、火、土、金’，强弱也是依次递减，这样才可以修炼本门仙法。
只有乙木仙门的凝珂仙子留下一枚玉简！
就这样我们五派一些外出寻找传承弟子的高手，一走就再也未回来，可能已经陨落在外面了吧，五派弟子越发凋零了。”
他原先所接触的人，像这些修仙最基本的概念谁个不知，但李言却是地地道道的一无所知。
这才是我五仙门最大的秘密，也是我们寻找传承最大的难点！”
“那小修士之事，后面若有时间再与你说。
而若要寻找门派传承弟子长时间在外时，至少要达到合体期才行，修为太弱长期在外，陨落的几率很大，尤其觊觎五仙门的敌人很多。
我们五派承受不起这种意外陨落，就是人丁太过稀少的缘故。
而最后在这样大浪淘沙中再找出五行依次相生的灵根，这概率……不言而喻了。
李言自是不敢打扰，灰衫老者很快继续说道。
因此除修炼时间外，外出寻找合适传承弟子时间往往只能集中某段时间，就这样，在世人眼里自然是我们鲜有外出。
至于为何不广开仙门招收弟子，这个方法上古就用过，收效甚微，还会暴露五仙门的秘密。
一方面自己要修炼大道，修仙一开始所时间还少些，可到了后面每一次闭关打坐可能是几十、上百年，这对于我们来说只是弹指一挥间罢了。
悠悠岁月就那样一路走来，而现在自己醒来，已不过是万事皆休，恍若一梦。
“一百多万年前，我闭关百年，待得出关之后，其余四门派也早已人去楼空，荒草遍地。
灰衫老者看出李言所想。
content_en:
However, the Five Immortals Sect still shows its head but not its tail, and rarely appears in the world.
"A powerful immortal method must have its fundamental reason for its power. I have also told you about several types of spiritual roots. Miscellaneous spiritual roots, mysterious spiritual roots, earth spiritual roots, heavenly spiritual roots, holy spirit roots and alien spiritual roots.
We are called the Five Immortal Gates, and they are divided into Guishui Immortal Gate, Yimu Immortal Gate, Dinghuo Immortal Gate, Jitu Immortal Gate, and Xinjin Immortal Gate. They correspond to the most sensitive attributes among the five elements.
Like the Yimu Immortal Sect, the immortal methods they practice are created for the wood attribute, so people who are sensitive to the wood aura can practice best; the Dinghuo Immortal Sect mainly focuses on the fire attribute.
However, the requirement of the Five Immortals Sect is not the Holy Spirit root, but that one person needs to possess all the attributes of the Five Elements at the same time in order to practice. "
Having said this, the old man in gray shirt paused for a moment.
"Miscellaneous spiritual roots?"
Although Li Yan was still in the dark about many things, he understood some of them and couldn't help but feel strange.
"This person's words are really strange. He used to say that those who cultivate immortality have the strongest spiritual roots, but now he seems to be saying that cultivating the mixed spiritual roots is the best."
"It's mixed spirit roots. This is the biggest secret of the ancient Five Immortals Sect. It's just that although we need people with mixed spirit roots, these are not ordinary mixed spirit roots.
Speaking of this, the old man in gray shirt had a low voice and a lonely look on his face, as if there was a trace of reminiscence.
Therefore, he must use other low-level methods to detect whether others have spiritual roots. "
In this mortal world alone, an ordinary cultivator may find one person out of a hundred thousand people. This takes into account the existence of any kind of spiritual root.
Li Yan was shocked when he heard that the legendary immortal was so close to him, and what he was thinking was reflected on his face.
Every inheritance requires a lot of effort to find the person to inherit the next generation. Each generation is basically a single person or a few people.
The expression of the old man in gray clothes dimmed. At this time, his figure was a little blurry than before, but Li Yan's heart was filled with fear, and he didn't notice it for a while.
Having said this, the old man in gray shirt had a look of arrogance on his face, and there was a domineering look on his sluggish face, which showed that he was disdainful of the immortal method he had practiced.
Of course, the mixed spiritual roots are sensitive to the five elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. Not only do we need the person to have the attributes of these five elements, but the attributes of the five elements must be arranged in order of strength according to the law of mutual generation.
It is more concealed and more reliable for us to use our spiritual sense to scan low-level immortal cultivators. Divine consciousness is a magical power of immortal cultivators. They can see everything clearly through walls and rooms without using eyes.
The strongest one that can sense the aura of heaven and earth should be 'gold', followed by water, wood, fire, and earth. If the latter one is stronger than the former one, you cannot practice the immortal method of 'Xinjin Immortal Sect'.
Then the attributes of the five elements in a cultivating person must also be arranged according to the strength and weakness of the five elements.
Similarly, the order in which our "Guishui Immortal Sect" senses the aura of heaven and earth is "water, wood, fire, earth, metal", and the strength is also decreasing in order, so that we can practice our own immortal method.
Only Fairy Ningke from the Yimu Immortal Sect left behind a jade slip!
In this way, some of the masters of our five sects who went out to look for disciples of the inheritance never came back. They may have died outside, and the disciples of the five sects were withering more and more. "
None of the people he had come into contact with knew the most basic concepts of cultivating immortality, but Li Yan was utterly clueless.
This is the biggest secret of my Five Immortals Sect, and also the biggest difficulty in finding our inheritance! "
"I'll tell you about the little monk thing later if I have time.
If you want to find a sect successor disciple who is away for a long time, you must at least reach the integration stage. If your cultivation is too weak and you are away for a long time, the chance of death is very high, especially there are many enemies who covet the Five Immortals Sect.
Our five sects cannot afford such an unexpected loss because our numbers are too few.
And in the end, the probability of finding the spiritual roots of the five elements that mutually generate each other in such a big wave is... self-evident.
Li YanziNot daring to interrupt, the old man in gray shirt quickly continued.
Therefore, apart from the time for cultivation, the time to go out to find suitable disciples can often only be concentrated in a certain period of time. In this way, in the eyes of the world, naturally we rarely go out.
As for why they don't open the Immortal Sect widely to recruit disciples, this method has been used in ancient times, with little effect, and will also expose the secrets of the Five Immortal Sects.
On the one hand, we have to practice Taoism. The time required to cultivate immortality is relatively small at the beginning, but in the future, each retreat may last for dozens or hundreds of years. For us, this is just a snap of the fingers.
The long years have gone by like that, and now when I wake up, everything has stopped, just like a dream.
"More than a million years ago, I was in seclusion for a hundred years. After I came out of seclusion, the other four sects had long since been deserted and the ground was covered with weeds.
The old man in gray shirt saw what Li Yan was thinking.
